jobs.title: Remote Software Engineer - Python/Typescript
jobs.description:
About Turing

Turing is one of the world’s leading AGI infrastructure companies, working with frontier AI labs to accelerate model development through high-quality training data, evaluations, and engineering talent.

About the Role

We’re looking for experienced, hands-on software engineers to help evaluate and improve AI coding models
.

Rather than primarily building production applications, you’ll work with coding agents across real-world repositories and assess the quality of their work. You’ll review generated code and agent behavior, determine whether solutions are technically correct, identify failure modes, and create the evaluation signals and feedback used to improve model performance.

Think of the coding agent as another engineer whose work you’re reviewing:
Can it understand the task? Did it choose the right approach? Is the resulting code correct, robust, and maintainable? Can you explain precisely where it succeeded or failed?

What You’ll Do:

Evaluate AI-generated code and solutions across real-world software repositories
Review agent behavior, tool usage, and code changes for correctness and quality
Identify technical errors, weak approaches, and recurring model failure modes
Compare model outputs and explain why one solution is better than another
Create and refine rubrics and evaluation criteria for coding tasks
Produce high-quality evaluation and preference data used to improve coding models
Build and maintain pipelines and infrastructure supporting data generation, collection, and evaluation workflows
Synthesize findings from data work into clear write-ups, updates, and recommendations for the team
Collaborate closely with researchers and engineers to translate qualitative judgment into scalable processes
Share clear, actionable findings with AI researchers and engineers

What We’re Looking For:

5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience

Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Go, or another major production language

Experience working in substantial real-world codebases
Strong code-review skills and technical judgment
Ability to clearly explain why an implementation is correct, incorrect, or could be improved
Strong written communication
Experience using modern LLMs or AI coding tools

Experience with LLM evaluation, coding agents, RLHF, preference data, rubric design, or post-training
is a plus, but not required.

Engagement Details:

Compensation:
Market rate; please provide a specific hourly rate expectation
Availability:
40 hours/week preferred, with at least 6 hours of Pacific Time overlap
Type:
Independent contractor
Duration:
Approximately 3 months
Start:
As soon as possible
Location:
North America, LATAM, or India

Evaluation Process:

AI interview (~25 minutes)
Practical code/AI evaluation exercise (~30 minutes)
Hiring manager interview (~20 minutes)

The practical exercise focuses on your ability to review and evaluate AI-generated code
, not competitive programming or algorithm puzzles.

About Mainspring
Mainspring Energy manufactures and delivers fuel-flexible, low-emissions local power solutions that rapidly add new capacity and deliver reliable, affordable, and sustainable electric power. The company began commercial shipments of its Mainspring Linear Generators in 2020 and today has hundreds of megawatts in advanced development and field operations for leading Fortune 500 companies, data centers, and utilities. Mainspring also partners with global energy leaders including AEP, NextEra Energy Resources, Schneider Electric, and more.

The core values that ground our work, guide our decisions, and connect us together:

Pragmatic Optimism

Excellence without Ego

Proactive Collaboration

Job Overview

Mainspring is seeking a Senior Product Integration Engineer (CAD) to own and maintain the integrated CAD definition of the Linear Generator as designs evolve. Design Engineers will continue to own the technical design and subsystem CAD; this role will make sure those designs are incorporated into authoritative POR and future-state reference assemblies and work together correctly in the context of the complete product.

This role combines product-definition ownership with hands-on whole-product CAD integration. The ideal candidate is exceptionally strong in 3D CAD, understands how complex mechanical systems fit together, and enjoys resolving packaging, interface, and configuration problems across multiple engineering teams. This role will be a key user of CATIA for full-product assemblies that exceed the practical limits of SolidWorks.

Core Responsibilities

• Build, maintain, and continuously improve authoritative POR and future-state reference assemblies for the Linear Generator

• Integrate subsystem CAD from multiple Design Engineering teams into full-product CATIA assemblies and keep those assemblies current as engineering changes progress

• Maintain clean full-product CAD structure, references, interfaces, metadata, and configuration logic across major assemblies

• Perform packaging studies, interference checks, clearance reviews, routing studies, service-access checks, and assembly-access evaluations

• Identify conflicting space claims and work with Design Engineers to negotiate interfaces and converge on practical whole-product solutions

• Create and maintain reference geometry, interface geometry, envelopes, simplified models, and other integration artifacts needed to support cross-team design work

• Support design reviews with clear visualizations of clashes, interfaces, access constraints, and product-level integration risks

• Identify and resolve inconsistencies among integrated CAD, drawings, EBOM structure, and the intended product configuration before release

• Support Product Release and Configuration Management by providing a clear, traceable digital definition of the product state being released

• Help establish scalable methods and standards for CATIA, large-assembly performance, imported geometry, simplification, reference assemblies, and cross-CAD workflows

Qualifications

• BS in Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, or a related technical field, or equivalent relevant experience

• 5+ years of experience in mechanical CAD, product design, packaging, product integration, or complex equipment design

• Advanced proficiency with CATIA, NX, Creo, SolidWorks, or another advanced 3D CAD platform; strong CATIA experience is highly preferred

• Demonstrated experience building and maintaining large, complex, multi-subsystem assemblies with disciplined reference and configuration practices

• Strong mechanical intuition and ability to identify packaging, clearance, routing, serviceability, assembly, and interface issues from 3D CAD

• Strong understanding of mechanical interfaces, drawings, GD&T, BOMs, revisions, and engineering change workflows

• Ability to communicate spatial and interface problems clearly and collaborate with engineers from multiple subsystem teams

• Detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable coordinating multiple design changes that affect interfacing hardware

• Experience integrating products containing structures, piping/tubing, electrical hardware, thermal systems, enclosures, and serviceable components

• Experience with SolidWorks-to-CATIA or other multi-CAD integration workflows

• Experience with ENOVIA, 3DEXPERIENCE, or another PLM/PDM system

Essential Responsibilities

Process patient and research specimens, including receipt, transport, accessioning, labeling verification, preparation, storage, and other pre-analytical activities, while maintaining specimen integrity and chain of custody.
Perform moderate- and high-complexity laboratory testing in accordance with validated methods, manufacturer instructions, standard operating procedures, the laboratory test menu, and the individual’s California license and documented competency.
Review test results for accuracy, completeness, and clinical validity; recognize abnormal, critical, or inconsistent findings; repeat or escalate testing as required; and report results through approved systems and workflows.
Perform, document, and review quality control, calibration, calibration verification, proficiency testing, method comparison, and parallel testing activities as assigned; identify trends and take or escalate corrective action when acceptance criteria are not met.
Operate laboratory instruments and equipment safely and competently; perform scheduled maintenance, function checks, and troubleshooting; coordinate service support; and document instrument status and corrective actions.
Maintain complete, accurate, timely, and traceable records in the laboratory information system and other approved systems, including test results, quality records, maintenance logs, reagent and supply documentation, and corrective actions.
Prepare, label, store, and track reagents, controls, calibrators, and supplies; monitor lot numbers, expiration dates, storage conditions, and inventory levels; and assist with ordering and receipt of laboratory materials.

Required Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree or higher from an accredited college or university in clinical laboratory science, medical technology, biological science, chemistry, or a related discipline that satisfies California licensure requirements.
Current, active, and unrestricted California Clinical Laboratory Scientist Generalist license issued by the California Department of Public Health, Laboratory Field Services. The license must be maintained in good standing throughout employment.
At least one year of clinical laboratory experience. Qualifying clinical training or internship experience may be considered when it meets applicable California licensing and organizational requirements.
Demonstrated knowledge of pre-analytical, analytical, and post-analytical laboratory processes; quality control principles; instrument maintenance; troubleshooting; and accurate result documentation.
Ability to perform only the testing authorized by the laboratory, the employee’s license, validated procedures, and documented training and competency.
Strong attention to detail, organization, judgment, problem-solving, interpersonal, and written and verbal communication skills.
Proficiency with computers and the ability to use laboratory information systems, electronic records, Microsoft Office applications, and other required technology.
Ability to maintain patient confidentiality and comply with applicable privacy, safety, quality, and laboratory requirements, including CLIA, California laboratory requirements, HIPAA, OSHA/Cal-OSHA, and START policies and procedures.

Preferred Education And Experience

National certification as a Medical Laboratory Scientist or Medical Technologist, such as MLS(ASCP), MT(ASCP), or an equivalent credential.
Experience in hematology, chemistry, immunology, urinalysis, coagulation, microbiology, or other areas applicable to the laboratory test menu.
Experience in oncology, clinical research, Phase I clinical trials, or a high-throughput patient-care laboratory.
Experience with laboratory information systems, quality management systems, proficiency testing, inspections, validations, and method comparisons.
Experience working in a California-licensed and CLIA-certified clinical laboratory; CAP-accredited laboratory experience is a plus.

Accountability: Takes ownership of responsibilities, decisions, and outcomes.
Performance Excellence: Maintains high standards for quality, productivity, and continuous improvement.
Results Orientation: Delivers measurable results aligned with team and organizational goals.

Constructive Dialogue: Raises concerns thoughtfully and challenges ideas respectfully. Integrity: Demonstrates ethical judgment and honesty in every action and decision.

Physical & Travel Requirements

Travel: Occasional travel may be required for training, meetings, or operational support.
Sitting/Standing: Must be able to sit and stand for extended periods and move throughout the laboratory and clinical work areas.
Bending/Reaching: Must be able to bend, stoop, reach overhead and at shoulder level, and access laboratory equipment and supplies.
Lifting: Must be able to lift, carry, push, or pull up to 40 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.
Manual Dexterity: Must be able to perform repetitive and fine-motor tasks, including pipetting, specimen handling, instrument operation, keyboarding, and use of laboratory tools.

Best-in-Class Benefits and Perks

Benefits

We value the time, talent, and dedication our employees bring to START. Our commitment to your well-being and growth is reflected in a competitive compensation package—based on experience—along with comprehensive benefits designed to support you both personally and professionally:

401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match
Eligibility for an annual performance bonus, based on role and company results

Employee Assistance Program (EAP) providing confidential, no ‑cost support for you and your family from day one

Commitment to a supportive environment that values balance, wellbeing, and flexibility
We’re committed to fostering a collaborative, creative workplace where every team member is encouraged to contribute. At START, you’ll join a team that values continuous learning, professional growth, shared ideas, and a culture built on inclusivity and innovation.

START clinical trial sites have conducted more than 1,000 early-phase clinical trials, including dozens of therapies that were approved by the FDA or EMA. new_jobs.description:
Brainlab revolutionized digital medical technology with the introduction of software for radiosurgery and surgical navigation. Today, Brainlab is an industry leader in digital surgery, radiotherapy and integrated operating rooms.

Serving physicians, medical professionals and patients in 6,000+ hospitals in 121 countries, we’re transforming healthcare to improve the lives of patients everywhere.

We employ over 2,000 people in 25 locations worldwide. Close-knit teams made of talented, curious and authentic people are working together toward a common goal.

Together we’re dedicated to making an impact.

Sound like you?

Join and grow with us.

Job Description

Provide on-site consulting and guidance to physicians and Operating Room (OR) personnel by evaluating options and problem-solving during surgery in order to maximize Brainlab product efficiency and usage.
Manage and maintain install base, including basic 3rd Party integrations.
Analyze and resolve product issues for Brainlab systems at assigned Account(s) via Salesforce through detailed analysis and utilization of critical thinking via technical training and documentation.
Utilize engineering expertise to contribute to the quality improvement process by recommending product modifications.
Provide clinical case coverage & support for Complex Cases and Go Live launches (based on availability).
Manage the process of driving customer utilization, especially via unique workflows and special applications.
Act as escalation point for clinical regional issues.
Direct and assist Radiology staff in performing necessary scans prior to surgery.
Educate/train physicians and hospital personnel, including OR staff, Radiology, Central Sterile Processing, Biomedical and Information Technologies staff, on the use of Image Guided Surgery (IGS) products and services.
Develop and conduct training programs for hospital staff enabling them to implement in-house training.
Act as primary customer liaison, maintaining contact with customer, assessing satisfaction and usage levels and providing recommendations on this process.
Work with the Application Consultant to increase revenue via the sale of spare parts, upgrades, contract renewal, etc.
Work closely with the Application Consultant, Area Account Manager, and Marketing Manager on market transparency, upgrade initiatives, demo/evaluations, and Research & Development (R&D) projects.
Attend meetings and trade shows to demonstrate and promote IGS products and services.
Keep abreast of developments regarding Brainlab and competitive IGS products and services via ongoing training and individual research and analysis.
Collaborate and strategize with Regional Support Manager to provide regular content for team calls/meetings (e.g. provide clinical knowledge transfer, share best practices, interesting cases or case set-ups, etc.).
Maintain Salesforce documentation of all working hours.
Attend IGS Continuing Education annually and maintain annual product certification competency.
This role will have some on call weekends

Salary range 70-85k.

Notwithstanding the foregoing, nothing in this job description alters your at-will employment status. Additional duties may be assigned in the discretion of Brainlab.

Qualifications

B.S. in Biomedical Engineering, Biomechanical Engineering, Bioengineering, Clinical Engineering, or Nursing required.
1-3 years minimum experience in a technical support role preferably for a healthcare company or Provider.
1-2 years minimum sales experience with healthcare company preferred.
Knowledge of surgical procedures, anatomy and medical terminology preferred.
Proficient in the use of PC software applications including Microsoft Office.
Self-motivated, detail oriented and a proven history of ability to make independent decisions.

Additional Information

In return for the experiences listed above we will provide a business casual environment, competitive compensation package including medical, dental, life, LTD, STD, and matching 401k benefits and much more.
